description: Información general en materia de Protección Civil (2025) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana (SSPC). Información general relacionada con protección civil. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana (SSPC). Its tags are alerta, amenaza natural, asistencia desastre, desastre, desastre natural. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
